title: Zack J Probable NDE 22299
content: I have written below the accounts of what I experienced from November 4, 2009 to 11 November, 2009 At approximately 1 pm on 4 November, 2009, I called an ambulance pick me up. When the Ambulance arrived, they found me in the entrance area to my home they found my Blood Pressure to be 210.They told me not to move and I kept my eyes closed as the room was spinning very quickly. I was transported to a hospital where I was admitted and the next day transported to another hospital. The events leading up to my transportation to hospital began on 3 November where my family and I enjoyed a barbeque with Friends where twelve adults consumed approximately five bottles of wine. When all the guests left for the evening at approximately 9:30 p.m., I went to bed. I did not feel intoxicated and nothing felt out of ordinary or unusual. Somewhere between 10 pm and 3 am the following events took place. I was asleep and at the same time very aware that I was physically traveling very fast through time. I was shown my life starting in the Stone Age. I was aware that I was hunting and interacting with other people, I was aware that I was a young man. I could see the landscape and saw my life being revealed in a minute to minute manner. This period ended in a flash of White and Orange. I then moved to the next life, I was in the Mountains and an Ocean where I was riding horses. I then moved to Europe and again aware of old buildings and Cities. I wasn't here for long and no there was no specific city I was aware of. I then came into the pyramid age and was approximately twenty to thirty years of age and was employed to assist in the building of the pyramids. At the time of the pyramids the area was not a desert, it seemed very lush, I saw in detail how the pyramids were built. Again, I saw my life in a moment to moment manner and was aware of eating dinner with other workers. There was no sense that we were slaves or in the situation under duress. I left this at approximately forty years of age. From this point, I flashed to Italy as a young boy and experienced each moment of my life once again to the current point of my life. I experienced each moment over again in every detail. Throughout each life, I traveled on my own. This point I am now suspended in space experiencing the universe being able to see for miles in every detail and color. I traveled again. I was suddenly in front of a very powerful being with a human form. I was aware of him being physically tall almost twice my size and very strong in stature. I got the sense that he was benevolent and powerful. I could feel his physical power standing in his presence. There were also three other beings with his with similar characteristics. Even though I was smaller in stature, I didn't feel small around him. He spoke to me and said I know things are bad down there, but you have to go back. I said I didn't want to go back and we then spoke about Heaven to my right and what we believe to be Hell on my left. We visited the negative place in which the people were dirty and in misery, it was emotionally and physically cold and confusing. The being explained that this is where people go for a short time because they acted inhumane during their earthly lives. Then he showed me Heaven, which was almost a white/yellow light with flowers where the people were happy and at peace, these people seemed to be waiting. Again, he told me to go back and we had a conversation about the need for me to go back, I asked for proof and he agreed that I will have proof. The proof he gave me has happened and is continuing to happen now. The proof he gave me was not in an area, which was of interest to me prior to this experience. At this point, I traveled very fast, landed in the Entry area of my home, and just as quickly traveled to my physical body this is approximately three meters over and three meters down to where I sleep. I hit my body with such force that my body bounced out of bed and I landed on the floor next to my bed. At this time, I was aware of my surroundings and I could not stand up at all due to severe dizziness, I crawled to the bathroom and then returned to bed, the clock in the bedroom read 3 a.m. I laid in bed and could not sleep as I felt not quite right and the visions of what I had seen through my journey were continuing through my mind. At 12:30 p.m. I called the Ambulance. These visions continued through until the 11 November 2009. Initially they were constant and fast moving, gradually slowed, and eventually stopped. This account is very broad as each area of my journey was revealed to me in great detail, I am unable to record each detail here. At no time during or since this experience have I experienced any physical pain or damage to my body. This can be confirmed by medical tests.

arrival.other_being_detail: A very powerful, benevolent, human-formed being ("physically tall almost twice my size and very strong"), with three other similar beings.

environment.environment_other_detail: Included multiple scenes described as Stone Age landscape; mountains and an ocean; Europe with old buildings and cities; pyramid-building area described as lush (not desert); "suspended in space" viewing the universe; a negative place that was cold/confusing with dirty/miserable people; and "Heaven" described as white/yellow light with flowers.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe dizziness/room spinning; very high blood pressure (210) leading to ambulance transport and hospitalization.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included repeated re-living of multiple apparent lifetimes (Stone Age; pyramid-building; Italy; etc.), viewing the universe from space, and visiting "Heaven" and a negative place described as what people believe to be "Hell."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience emphasized rapid travel through multiple lives/eras and realms, then encounter with powerful beings, then shown negative place and Heaven, then rapid return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Extended, detailed re-experiencing of multiple apparent past lives across historical eras (Stone Age, pyramid age, etc.), followed by being shown both Heaven and a negative place described as a temporary destination for those who acted inhumane.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was asleep and at the same time very aware that I was physically traveling very fast through time.” “He spoke to me and said I know things are bad down there, but you have to go back.” “Heaven, which was almost a white/yellow light with flowers where the people were happy and at peace.”
